The provided policy documents do not contain information regarding your specific attendance records or which of your courses are currently below the attendance requirement.

Regarding whether a shortfall can be condoned:
*   If your attendance is **at least 65% but below 75%**, the shortfall may be condoned on medical or other documented grounds [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
*   To request this, you must submit an application with supporting documents to the Head of Department and pay a fee of ₹500 per course before the last teaching day of the term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
*   You may receive condonation for a maximum of two courses per term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
*   If your attendance is **below 65%**, you are detained in that course and cannot be granted condonation [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §4].
